title: Fare Review Team Standard: The Wrong Drop-Off Review Amount on Wayfare Rides
content:
The wrong drop-off review amount for a trip of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** is the fare still standing on the trip multiplied by the stranding share, then by the member review multiplier, then by the review timeliness factor, plus the onward-journey reimbursement and the luggage allowance; the total is limited to the review request cap and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Fare still standing on the trip.** The fare charge amount less the fare adjustments booked on the trip (taken as a positive total).

## Values

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Stranding share | 0.20 (20 percent of the fare still standing) |
| Member review multiplier | 1.0 |
| Review timeliness factor | 1.0 |
| Onward-journey reimbursement | nil ($0.00) |
| Luggage allowance | nil ($0.00) |
| Review request cap | $25.00 |

## Structure of the amount

1. Fare still standing: the fare charge amount less the fare adjustments booked on the trip.
2. Multiplied figure: the fare still standing multiplied by the stranding share, then by the member review multiplier, then by the review timeliness factor.
3. Total: the multiplied figure plus the onward-journey reimbursement and the luggage allowance, in dollars.
4. Capped total: the total limited to the review request cap.
5. Review amount: the capped total rounded half up to the cent, once.

No intermediate figure is rounded; the cap applies to the total after the dollar amounts are added.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

*No fare adjustment on the trip.* Fare charge $28.40. Fare still standing $28.40; multiplied by 0.20 is $5.68, by 1.0 and by 1.0 stays $5.68; plus $0.00 and $0.00; below the $25.00 cap. The review amount is **$5.68**.

*A fare adjustment already booked.* Fare charge $31.15 with a fare adjustment of $3.27 booked on the trip. Fare still standing $27.88; multiplied by 0.20 is $5.576; rounded at the end, **$5.58**.
